description: Introducing Nebula, a free custom visual for Power BI that empowers you to design captivating report backgrounds directly within the platform. Say goodbye to external design tools and enhance your reports with ease. Key Features: Integrated Design Environment: Craft visually appealing backgrounds without leaving Power BI, streamlining your workflow, and ensuring seamless visual alignment. Simplified Report Creation: Reduce clutter by eliminating the need for multiple background elements on a page , resulting in cleaner and more professional reports. Optimized Performance: Enhance the aesthetic appeal of your reports without compromising performance, ensuring quick load times and smooth user interactions. Elevate your Power BI reports effortlessly with Nebula's intuitive design capabilities. For more information visit https://bisamurai.com/nebula/.
